stories.label: Sri Lanka arrests ex-intelligence chief over 2019 Easter bombings
stories.summary: Sri Lanka's former intelligence chief arrested over the 2019 Easter Sunday bombings that killed 279. Seven years of apparent impunity broken. Intelligence agencies had advance warning but failed to act.

stories.label: Sudan war — UNSC condemns RSF atrocities in Kordofan
stories.summary: UN Security Council formally condemned RSF atrocities in Kordofan — mass killings, sexual violence, attacks on aid workers. First significant UNSC action after months of paralysis. MSF closed El Tina hospital on Chad border. Quad ceasefire proposal still on table.

stories.label: Syria faces twin-front war — Assad remnants and ISIL attack new government
stories.summary: Post-Assad Syrian government fighting simultaneously against regime remnants in Latakia (west) and ISIL insurgents in the east. Revolution's survival being tested three months after toppling Assad.

stories.label: 6.5 million in Somalia face severe hunger as drought deepens
stories.summary: UN reports 6.5 million Somalis — nearly half the population — face severe hunger. Drought compounded by Al-Shabaab blocking aid access and US funding freezes. Horn of Africa's worst drought sequence in 40 years.

stories.label: Singapore publishes wealth distribution data for first time
stories.summary: Singapore Finance Ministry reveals richest 1% own 14% of assets — dramatically lower than US (~30%) or UK (~21%). First-ever publication of wealth distribution data from a major financial center.

stories.label: WiseTech cuts 2,000 jobs as AI replaces software engineers
stories.summary: WiseTech Global cutting one-third of workforce (2,000 jobs across 40 countries), explicitly attributing layoffs to AI ending the era of 'manually writing code.' Profitable company making strategic bet that AI replaces engineers.

stories.label: South Africa retrieves 11 men lured into fighting in Russia's Ukraine war
stories.summary: South Africa secured return of 11 men 'lured' into Russia-Ukraine war. Ramaphosa thanked Putin for cooperation. Part of broader pattern of Russia recruiting fighters from Global South — Nepal, India, Sudan, Cuba.

stories.label: Pakistan-Afghanistan forces trade fire at border amid multi-front crisis
stories.summary: Pakistan-Afghanistan border war continues. KSE-100 crashed another 1,600 points (3rd straight day). Multiple domestic attacks. Multi-front crisis deepening.

stories.label: Israeli forces fired 900+ bullets killing 15 Gaza medics execution-style
stories.summary: Forensic investigation found Israeli soldiers fired 900+ bullets at aid workers, killing 15 execution-style. Satellite imagery shows evidence concealment. CPJ now reports Israel killed 86 journalists in 2025 — most by any country for second consecutive year.

stories.label: Pentagon threatens Anthropic with Cold War-era powers over military AI
stories.summary: Pentagon gave Anthropic Friday deadline to agree to unrestricted military AI use or face Defense Production Act. Outcome expected Friday Feb 27.

stories.label: Iran crisis — Geneva talks Thursday, US armada assembling
stories.summary: Geneva talks set for Thursday Feb 26. CIA issued Farsi-language appeal to Iranian people. Trump SOTU reiterated preference for diplomatic solution while military buildup continues. Iran regime cracking down on student protests. Not covered this cycle — threshold requires outcome, not positioning.

stories.label: Japan to deploy missiles on island 110km from Taiwan by 2031
stories.summary: Japan deploying missiles to Yonaguni island, 110km from Taiwan, by 2031. Part of post-2022 remilitarization.

stories.label: Amazon accused of systematic scheme to inflate prices across economy
stories.summary: Investigation reveals Amazon operating systematic scheme to inflate prices across the entire economy. Watch for FTC/DOJ follow-up.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia war — year 5 grinds on
stories.summary: War grinds into year 5. South African men revealed as among those lured to fight for Russia. No diplomatic breakthrough.

stories.label: US tells Afghan allies to give up — 173-year resettlement backlog
stories.summary: DHS admits 173-year processing backlog. 180,000 Afghans in pipeline. Camp As-Sayliyah closing March 31.

stories.label: Lebanon army ordered to respond after Israeli fire on military post
stories.summary: Lebanese Army authorized to return fire after Israeli forces fired on military post. Watch for actual engagement.

stories.label: Thai and Cambodian armies exchange fire at disputed border
stories.summary: Thai-Cambodia border situation quiet this cycle but unresolved. Ammunition depot explosion reported at Thai border patrol facility.

stories.label: Mercury 2 diffusion-based LLM challenges autoregressive AI paradigm
stories.summary: Inception Labs' diffusion-based LLM. Awaiting independent verification of benchmark claims.

stories.label: Brazil floods kill 28+ in Minas Gerais
stories.summary: Death toll rising. Rescuers still searching for dozens missing. Same La Niña pattern driving Horn of Africa drought.

stories.label: Stripe reportedly in talks to acquire PayPal
stories.summary: Bloomberg report only, not confirmed. Would be one of largest fintech deals ever.

stories.label: M23 spokesperson killed in drone strike — Congo mineral war
stories.summary: M23 spokesperson killed by drone in eastern DRC. DRC-Burundi border reopened.

stories.label: Israel orders 37 aid organizations to halt operations in Gaza and West Bank
stories.summary: 37 aid groups ordered to halt all operations. Connected to medics massacre and CPJ journalist killings report — systematic dismantling of humanitarian and press access.

stories.label: ICC prosecution: Duterte drew up 'death lists' for drug war
stories.summary: ICC hearing ongoing. Importance decaying as hearing moves into procedural phase.

stories.label: US tariff upheaval — Section 122 tariffs in effect
stories.summary: Trump SOTU reiterated tariff policy. No major new development. Fading.

stories.label: China-Japan export war / US chip control regime under pressure
stories.summary: New German chancellor Merz visiting China — trade focus. Export control tensions continue.

stories.label: Sahel jihadist groups probing coastal West Africa
stories.summary: Senegal PM now seeking 10-year prison terms for same-sex relations, separate from security issue. Jihadist expansion continues.

stories.label: Mexico CJNG crisis — aftermath of El Mencho death
stories.summary: Mexico says situation stabilized, flights resuming. 70+ killed in aftermath.

stories.label: Settlers kill Palestinian teen while Israeli soldiers watched
stories.summary: Military complicity pattern documented.

stories.label: Netanyahu-Modi 'hexagon' alliance — Modi visits Israel
stories.summary: Modi visiting Israel, first Indian PM to address Knesset. Defence and trade deepening.

stories.label: Israel targets press — 86 journalists killed in 2025 (CPJ)
stories.summary: CPJ report: Israel killed 86 journalists in 2025, most by any country for second year. 5 Palestinian outlets designated terrorist groups.

stories.label: Chinese scientists build world's smallest transistor for AI chips
stories.summary: Ferroelectric transistor integrating memory and processing. Alternative architecture path.

stories.label: Russia opens criminal case against Telegram founder Durov
stories.summary: Both France and Russia pursuing criminal cases against Durov.

stories.label: Nigeria central bank cuts rate to 26.5%
stories.summary: Nigeria cut benchmark rate to 26.5%. Inflation above 30%.

stories.label: Moscow bomb kills police officer on Ukraine war anniversary
stories.summary: Internal security strain in Russia.

stories.label: US withdraws from NE Syria, abandoning Kurdish allies
stories.summary: US pulling out of NE Syria. Full withdrawal within a month.

stories.label: Panama takes control of canal ports from Hong Kong firm
stories.summary: Supreme Court declared CK Hutchison concession unconstitutional.

stories.label: Deadly floods sweep Peru — 700+ districts in emergency
stories.summary: Same La Niña weather pattern as Brazil floods and Horn of Africa drought.

stories.label: IBM posts worst day in 25 years after AI threatens COBOL moat
stories.summary: IBM stock crashed after AI showed it can modernize COBOL.

stories.label: Hidden human labor behind 'autonomous' humanoid robots exposed
stories.summary: MIT Tech Review reveals humanoid robot companies hiding human operators.
